Name: Elioenai, Son of Becher
Summary: Son of Becher, named among the sons of Becher.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:8: Son of Becher, named among the sons of Becher.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Elioenai stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
